description: Synthetic MapList validation cases for the Harmony Touch editor. No real activity, device, or hub data. Small integer ids are invented. stock records what the stock button-map reader does with the case: throws, or loads it (ok) even when Melodious validation rejects it.

cases.name: invalid-button-missing-type
cases.errorIncludes: button with an unknown or missing __type

cases.name: invalid-sequence-step-type
cases.errorIncludes: step with an unknown or missing __type

cases.name: invalid-sequence-delay-no-duration
cases.errorIncludes: delay step without a numeric Duration
